title: Software Verification Summary: INCOMPLETE - one host unit sweep recorded, no integration, no qualification, no target-hardware run

standards_mappings.rationale: This is the reporting counterpart of FB2-VER-UTS-000001, FB2-VER-SIP-000001 and FB2-VER-SQP-000001. It reports the state those three plans describe. It is a summary, not a result, and it changes no process disposition by itself.
standards_mappings.relationship_note: The rationale says so in its own words ('it is a summary, not a result'): the clause is named for traceability or to record a boundary or an absence, and the record draws no content from the clause and claims nothing about it. The disposition is carried by `status`; the relationship is not a mapping from this record onto the clause.

standards_mappings.rationale: Summary of the software verification evidence available for the three named software requirements.
standards_mappings.relationship_note: The rationale states the derivation explicitly ('summary of the software verification evidence'): this record was written from the clause's concept, or supplies the work product the clause expects, or consumes the one the clause produces. The clause is the intellectual source of the content, which is what `derivation_basis` names. It is NOT a conformance claim: no clause text was consulted, no assessment was performed, and the clause is not a yardstick this record was measured against.

revision_history.author: verification_lead
revision_history.description: First issue. Reports the state established by the single recorded host sweep and by the absence of integration, qualification and target-hardware evidence.

revision_history.author: verification_lead
revision_history.description: Corrected the product-attributed build-failure count from 15 to 17, the value its own enumeration produces, and published the 39 host-attributed and 56 build-class subtotals so that the headline 84 is not read as 84 compiler failures. Also carried the 191 to 209 correction into the translation-unit-with-edge figure taken from FB2-VER-SIP-000001. Every other published figure was re-derived from its tracked source and holds as before.

summary_basis: Everything below is read from one place: the recorded macOS arm64 host sweep of the SIL Ceedling harness, evidence file docs/artifacts/evidence/actual-runs/foxbms2-sil-host-unit-test-macos-2026-09-29/results-sil-all.json, generated 2026-09-30T01:24:18+0200, together with the classification, re-attribution and vacuity findings in the same run directory, and the three plans this corpus now holds. No figure in this summary is from any other source, and no figure is estimated.
period: 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-01. The recorded sweep is dated 2026-09-30; the specifications, plan and this summary are dated 2026-10-01. The tree the sweep measured is not the tree as it now stands.

overall_verdict.statement: VERIFICATION IS INCOMPLETE. One level of software verification has produced a recorded result: unit verification, executed once on a host. Software integration has not been executed at all, 0 of 9 ordered steps. Software qualification has not been executed at all. No target-hardware verification has been performed. Of the three software requirements the corpus names, one is partially verified at unit level and two are not verified at unit level. Nothing in this corpus demonstrates that the foxBMS 2 product meets its software requirements, and no artefact in it is approved.

what_was_verified.item: Unit behaviour of the modules that have a test file and a recorded green result
what_was_verified.how: Ceedling 1.1.9-2209dc2 with CMock 2.7.2 and Unity 2.7.2, compiled by gcc/clang 17.0.0 on arm64-apple-darwin27, over 313 targets, against SIL HL_* interface headers generated per test from the host-declared interface headers. The sweep is deterministic: the run directory records a 24-run classifier determinism check.

what_was_verified.item: The internal consistency of 39 LTC command arrays' PEC bytes against the product's own PEC implementation
what_was_verified.how: TEST_ASSERT_PEC_CORRECT_IN_ARRAY compares the PEC bytes stored in each ltc_cmd* constant table against LTC_CalculatePec15 applied to the same table. This establishes that the tables and the polynomial have not drifted apart. It does not establish that either is correct against the device protocol, and a consistently wrong PEC passes all 39 assertions.

23 cases and 117 Unity assertions across two test files, the only place in the suite that uses TEST_ASSERT_EQUAL_MEMORY to compare whole payloads rather than selected fields. Green in the recorded run: 14 cases and 9 cases, 0 failures.
26 deviation records in the corpus document justified departures from the coding guidelines. The corpus has not itself run the formatter over the tree.

what_passed.statement: The recorded sweep reports 222 of 313 targets green and 950 of 988 assertions passed. Read with the qualification below, not without it: 5 of the 222 green targets contain no Unity assertion at all, so the count of green targets that assert something is 217, and the count of modules whose behaviour is verified is far smaller again because the oracle behind many of the assertions is a mock queue the test itself authored.
items: 213 green targets that contain at least one Unity assertion and at least one test case, with 0 failed assertions recorded among them.
LTC 6813-1 PEC drift pin: 1 case, 39 assertions, 0 failures.
SOC estimator, all four strategies: 15 cases, 56 assertions, 0 failures.

what_failed.statement: 7 targets failed with 35 failed assertions out of 72 tested, and 84 targets did not build at all. The failures are not all the same kind of thing and the distinction matters: some are product defects, some are harness limitations, and one is a linker crash on this host.
items: tests/unit/app/driver/phy/test_dp83869.c: 15 cases, 15 assertions, 0 passed, 15 failed. The single worst result in the run. The cause is documented in TASK2-SEGFAULT.md in the same run directory: the linker crashes on this host, and AddressSanitizer hangs at the link step because the shipped :tools: :test_linker: appends -flto, which deadlocks this toolchain under ASAN. This is a harness-infrastructure failure, not 15 product defects, so the module is neither verified nor disproven.

84 of 313 targets did not build, in 13 classifier classes. 17 of the 84 are attributed to the product rather than to the harness or to configuration: 16 on a build:real_defect_* class (6 out-of-bounds array index, 4 macro arity, 2 implicit function declaration, 2 implicit int, 1 absolute-value truncation, 1 excess initialisers) plus 1 on build:product_tautological_guard: 6 out-of-bounds array index, 4 macro arity, 2 implicit function declaration, 2 implicit int, 1 absolute-value truncation, 1 excess initialisers, 1 tautological guard. A further 8 are undeclared identifier. 28 are excluded upstream by configuration, 22 fail only a clang-specific diagnostic, 5 fail a strict diagnostic under both compilers, 1 is not buildable on the macOS object format and 3 are SIL interface header mismatches. The 17 defect-attributed ones are unresolved product defects as far as this corpus is concerned.

5 green targets assert nothing: tests/unit/app/main/test_fassert.c, tests/unit/bootloader/main/test_fassert.c, tests/unit/app/engine/sys/test_reset.c, tests/unit/app/driver/afe/debug/can/api/test_debug_can_afe_dma.c, tests/unit/app/driver/afe/debug/default/api/test_debug_default_afe_dma.c. Each declares one test case, calls the code under test, and contains zero TEST_ASSERT_ macros. They contribute 5 to the pass count and 0 to any coverage claim.

21 of 313 test files declare no test case at all, and all 21 are build failures, so they inflate nothing. They are concentrated in the two AFE shared layers: ADI ADES183x at 13 files and NXP MC3377x at 6, plus test_emac-low-level.c and test_fake_functions.c.

tests/unit/app/application/soa/test_soa.c passes with 2 cases and 3 assertions, all of them NULL-pointer traps, and its routine output-verification step is the literal text /* TODO */. A green verdict that verifies no behaviour of the module FB2-SW-SWR-000002 is written about.

what_is_blocked.statement: Four things are blocked. None of them is blocked because the work is hard; three are blocked because the artefact that would unblock them has not been authored, and one is blocked because the hardware does not exist in this corpus.

items.item: Software integration testing, all 5 levels, 0 of 9 ordered steps executed
items.blocked_because: The SW Integration Test Specification does not exist. FB2-VER-TMS-000007 is a planning stub with 3 steps and no oracles. A plan is not a specification: FB2-VER-SIP-000001 gives an order and criteria, and without oracles the order is a schedule.
items.unblock_condition: Author an integration test specification with an oracle per step, then execute IL-01. IL-01 is partially executable now once the 84 build failures are cleared.

items.item: Software integration levels IL-02 through IL-05
items.blocked_because: No FreeRTOS host build, no task-period observation capability, no CAN frame observer, no SPI or DMA hardware or model, and no target board. The HL_* interface headers the harness supplies are CMock doubles: 38 distinct headers, with HL_spi required by 70 tests, HL_can by 69 and HL_het by 60, and none of them can observe the peripheral they stand for.
items.unblock_condition: A FreeRTOS host build, a CAN bus simulator or controller with frame observation, and an SPI/DAM model. Hardware, not authoring.

items.item: Software qualification, FB2-VER-EXE-000008 and the five network-security measures FB2-VER-TMS-000016..000020
items.blocked_because: The SW Qualification Test Specification does not exist and no qualification level has been executed. Every latency acceptance criterion in the three software requirements is a wall-clock criterion and the host harness has no wall-clock oracle.
items.unblock_condition: Author the qualification specification with a measurable oracle per criterion, then run it on a target board with a real time base.

items.item: The debounce and reaction-path criteria of FB2-SW-SWR-000002
items.blocked_because: FB2-SW-DSN-000005's own declared_gaps records that the SOA module contains no debounce and no reaction path. The requirement specifies behaviour the source does not contain, so there is nothing to verify and no harness that could produce a result.
items.unblock_condition: A human decision: either withdraw the debounce criterion from FB2-SW-SWR-000002, or add a debounce and reaction path to the SOA module. No amount of harness work resolves this.

target_hardware.statement: NO TARGET-HARDWARE VERIFICATION WAS PERFORMED. Every result in this corpus was produced by a host build of the product's own C sources on an Apple Silicon Mac, against mocked interface headers. The run directory's RUNBOOK.md reproduces a host run and states that the SIL workspace symlinks src/, tests/ and conf/ read-only into an isolated build root. The corpus's own coverage report reads 0 target-hardware executions, and records 15 host/simulation executions as real product code but not target hardware. The sil/ directory in the harness exists precisely to substitute for the hardware, and the substitution is not a small one.
target_hardware.what_a_target_run_would_add: Everything the host substitutes for, which is most of what a BMS does. The FreeRTOS scheduler and the real task periods behind every timing criterion; the real interrupt and DMA completion paths by which a cell voltage reaches the database; the SPI transfer ordering and the het pin multiplexer that select the cell; the CAN wire behaviour and the frame that carries a diagnosis; the FRAM and flash drivers; and a real time base, without which not one of the latency criteria in FB2-SW-SWR-000001, 000002 or 000003 can be measured. A target run would also be the first evidence in this corpus that the product behaves as its sources suggest when the sources are the ones actually compiled onto the board.

outstanding: Execute the 84 build failures, or record a decision for each. 15 are classified as real product defects and are unresolved.

Decide, per vacuous test, whether a specification is wanted. The corpus's own finding states that writing tests for the config-module cases would be inventing the specification, so this is a specification decision and not an engineering one.
Give the SOA module an outcome oracle, or accept that FB2-SW-SWR-000002 has no unit verification of behaviour.
Resolve the FB2-SW-SWR-000002 debounce contradiction between the requirement and the source.
Author the SW Integration Test Specification and the SW Qualification Test Specification. Both expected families are absent.
Obtain a coverage measurement. Until one exists, no percentage of this product is known to anyone, and PC-006 stays unmet.

Clear the 19 zero-test-case AFE shared-layer test files by decision or by test. The ADI ADES183x and NXP MC3377x shared layers are the only code in the tree instantiated by more than one vendor, so an undetected defect there multiplies.
Perform a target-hardware run and record it with input and output hashes.
Have a person who did not author the code review the verification. Every artefact in this corpus is AI-authored and none is approved; PC-011 is unmet and is not a formality.

independence_statement: No verification in this corpus was performed independently. Every artefact is AI-authored, every human_approval_status is pending and every production_authorized flag is false. An AI-authored review is not independence: the pass criteria PC-011 in FB2-VER-SQP-000001 requires a person who did not author the code, and no such person has reviewed anything here. This summary is itself AI-authored from the same sources the tests were derived from, so its judgements about what the tests do and do not verify have not been checked by anyone either.
limitations: The recorded sweep is a point-in-time measurement. The tree has moved since: commit 176fe234 landed after the sweep was generated and its own message reads 251/313 pass, so the recorded 222 is not a current figure and no re-run has been performed.
This summary reports recorded results and the absence of results. It does not and cannot make the verification complete.

The 217 figure is a join between the recorded outcomes and the current test sources. Where the tree has changed since the sweep, a target's recorded verdict and its current content no longer correspond, and this summary says so rather than reconciling the two.
No coverage measurement underlies any statement here. The 988 assertions executed is not a coverage figure and is not used as one.
The 17 build failures attributed to the product are the run's own classifier output. This summary reports the classification and does not independently re-derive each defect.
The linker crash affecting test_dp83869.c is diagnosed in TASK2-SEGFAULT.md as a host toolchain problem. That diagnosis is the run's; it was not re-tested here.
